status: Read-only ownership review; not a new measurement or experiment

fresh_same_boot_observation.scope: Ordinary process RSS only. Do not sum these values with requested-live bytes or derive complete kernel/system-memory totals from this note.
fresh_same_boot_observation.phase_note: WT1890.3671875MiB is the measured phase, not ready. Ready is1887.7421875MiB. Native ready/measured areboth116.41796875MiB; all values checked against hash-matched raw receipts.

ownership_groups.name: Quinn connection owner
ownership_groups.interpretation: Allocation embeds proto::Connection, high-level mutex/state, notification fields and handles. Largest owner, not all proven avoidable.

ownership_groups.name: Packet encryption keys
ownership_groups.interpretation: Four packet keys per typical connection; current eager key-update preparation preserved. Real AES schedule/GHASH plus enum representation.

ownership_groups.name: Header protection keys
ownership_groups.interpretation: Separate HKDF-derived secret from packet encryption; no schedule sharing assumed.

ownership_groups.name: Relay application task
ownership_groups.interpretation: Active async application task allocation. Moving these futures into boxes does not prove net memory reduction.

ownership_groups.name: Rustls session
ownership_groups.interpretation: Includes Rustls QUIC connection and successor secrets; not removable after handshake without preserving TLS parsing/errors/exporter/tickets.

ownership_groups.name: Final Rustls state box
ownership_groups.interpretation: Final server TLS state, exporter and TLS traffic schedule. Prior exporter-only change rejected.

ownership_groups.name: HTTP CONNECT capsule task
ownership_groups.interpretation: Required capsule close handling remains active; cannot simply drop after established IO conversion.

ownership_groups.name: Raw vector roots
ownership_groups.interpretation: Aggregate allocation site, not a single owner. Do not classify all bytes as avoidable without deeper stack attribution.

ownership_groups.name: Stream/lookup tables
ownership_groups.interpretation: Active stream/lookup storage; immutable sparse credits and empty-state work already retained. No claim all bytes removable.

current_stack_ceiling: Fresh native ready RSS is116.41796875MiB, while one measured Quinn owner class alone requests509.64MiB at100k and packet/header key classes together request268.59MiB. Under unchanged resident representations, local HTTP adapter/pool fixes cannot reach this RSS target.
This does not prove a universal QUIC memory lower bound. The observations are implementation footprints of the selected encrypted QUIC/TLS stack versus the native plaintext WebSocket process.
The remaining HTTP112B established handle is already compact; setup-only metadata was released by49f266e. Dropping HTTPcapsule/TLS owners wholesale would break required behavior.
A direct quinn-proto integration alone still retains protocol/key state; its value must be measured rather than inferred from deleting Tokio API wrappers.

Reaching the full target likely requires both compact crypto/protocol representations and worker-owned application/runtime state, not an accumulation of tiny allocation caches. No byte saving for that architecture is claimed.

next_measurable_target.choice: Execute already-staged server-only ChaCha20-preferred CPU/full-throughput screen before any Ring representation change
next_measurable_target.why: Large actual key-owner cost and a source-proven enum-padding mechanism. Keeps eager key timing and existing primitives, distinct from rejected lazy expansion.
gates: Confirm actual negotiated suite with existing Rustls debug logging in a separate diagnostic; provider ordering alone is insufficient with client-preference default.
Keep fixed clients and ordinary matched private/room/mixed throughput; include reliable stress, datagrams and CPU accounting.
If whole-workload behavior is acceptable, then consider only narrow Ring enum ownership compaction with all AESfallbacks and no-alloc feature behavior preserved.
A cipher-preference change alone does not shrink current Ring object allocations; do not claim an idle-memory benefit until the representation candidate has full live-allocation/RSS verification.
Do not bypass receiver refusal or resource budgets to obtain acceptance.

prior_work_not_to_repeat: Exporter-only TLS final-state replacement saved13.70MiB and was rejected on throughput.
Initial-only packet-key expansion deferral saved110.76MiB but repeated reliable-load failures; do not move more expansion onto traffic path.
Grouped driver futures saved little task storage and regressed throughput; not equivalent to a validated worker-owned protocol redesign.
Lazy migration storage and inline receive assembler candidates had measured memory savings but failed complete acceptance.
limits: No new builds, timings, workloads or production changes were performed for this note.
Exact current field-level compiler layout of the2048B application task and5344B Quinn allocation was not refreshed; no precise avoidable-byte claim for those owners.
Header shadow census and ChaCha preference artifacts remain unexecuted as of this note.
This note makes no full kernel-memory total, user-plus-kernel total or universal native-versus-QUIC memory ratio claim.
